title: Qatari Diar lists $64 million London penthouse at redeveloped Chelsea Barracks site
summary_full: A new duplex penthouse at London's Chelsea Barracks is now for sale. This luxury property is listed for forty-eight million pounds, making it very expensive. The development transformed a historic British Army barracks into a high-end residential neighborhood. Buyers can move into the fully furnished home which includes extensive outdoor terraces. This listing highlights London's ultra-prime housing market's renewed momentum.
